title.zh: v2.0.92 切曲风时延迟尾巴不再被砍断
title.en: v2.0.92 Switching Genres No Longer Cuts the Delay Tail

highlights.zh: **乒乓开关一按，整条延迟图被重建、旧图被当场断开。** 于是还在延迟线里回荡的尾巴在一个采样里消失——切换那一刻的咔哒声。这条路径实测可达：`genreFx.ts` 里有 **11 处** `pingPong: true`（dub 一脉等），切到或切离这些曲风就会触发重建。
highlights.en: **Toggling ping-pong rebuilt the whole delay graph and disconnected the old one on the spot.** Whatever was still ringing in its delay line vanished in a single sample — the click at the moment of the switch. The path is reachable in practice: **11** genre profiles carry `pingPong: true` (the dub lineage among them), and moving to or away from any of them triggers a rebuild.

highlights.zh: **现在每个 build 有自己的输出增益，旧 build 不断线、只淡出。** 它不再接收新的发送，但**已经录进它延迟线里的东西继续在响**，尾音交给新 build 接上。两种拓扑的内部结构一行没动——居中的那条延迟线仍是单节点、天然保留立体声，连单声道发送也照样居中。
highlights.en: **Each build now has its own output gain, so the replaced build is faded out instead of disconnected.** It stops receiving new send, but **what is already in its delay line keeps sounding** and hands the tail over to the new build. Neither topology changed internally — the centred delay is still a single node that preserves stereo by construction, and a mono send still stays centred.

highlights.zh: **淡出窗跟着延迟时间走（0.25–0.5 s）**，因为新 build 的延迟线一开始是空的，它的第一声回声要等一个延迟时间才到，这段空档得由旧尾音盖住：固定 250 ms 只盖得住 120 BPM 的 1/8，60 BPM 的 1/4 会露洞。下限 250 ms 保证无咔哒（本文件其余斜坡是 12–20 ms），上限 500 ms 是因为再长切换就不像切换了。
highlights.en: **The fade window follows the delay time (0.25–0.5 s)**, because the new build's delay line starts empty: its first repeat arrives one delay time later, and the outgoing tail is what covers that gap. A fixed 250 ms covers a 1/8 at 120 BPM but leaves a hole at a 1/4 at 60 BPM. The 250 ms floor keeps it click-free (the file's other ramps are 12–20 ms); the 500 ms ceiling is where a switch stops feeling like a switch.
